_comment: Automatic spec-status rules read by crew-ls.py --reconcile; tried in file order, first match wins. kind: ready and stalled are report-only; hold rewrites Status using `status` and logs `log` (fields: idle_days, prior, from_state). Predicates are defined in crew-ls.py. DONE is written only by `crew-ls.py --mark-done` from crew open pr; IMPLEMENTING only by `--mark-implementing`.
